topic: New indoor footfall estimation tool shared
summary_markdown:
A new application was presented that provides authenticated, source-backed footfall estimates for indoor locations. The tool accepts a place name or coordinates, resolves the location and venue type (e.g., mall, airport), and extracts daily, monthly, or annual footfall metrics from official primary sources (reports, government/authority data). Results are returned with structured data, direct source links, and confidence levels.

[p8] shared the tool for others to test, verify results, and integrate into other applications. The initial testing by [me] and [p11] showed promising results.
action_items: Team members are asked to use the provided tool link to test it and provide feedback on improvements.
